accounting_policy: Fresh explicit root activation, absolute stop time and separate immutable run directory are required before any request.
Reserve each actual HTTP attempt serially before transport. Charge redirects, denials, failures and partial bodies; no automatic retries or automatic redirects.
The 65 exact retained targets are ordered by historical request sequence, including shared welcome/catalog only once. This is not a guarantee of 65 future events.

Count received body bytes per response, even if content hashes duplicate. Exact URL reuse may avoid a second request only with an explicit alias to the first verified result and all associations preserved.
Distinct URLs compare exact requested strings. Do not erase query/suffix/percent-encoding differences. New redirects require exact retained Location proof and explicit approval within caps.
Stop before an unaffordable request; use remaining aggregate capacity as the response cap. Unknown transfer accounting, truncation or unapproved target stops the run; retain prior evidence.
Record actual source acquisition times separately from this preparation time and any future repository intake.
success_criteria: Fresh captured welcome/catalog validates the complete 18-agency department roster and the exact three selected identities; catalog changes require plan reconciliation, not silent expansion.

Each selected agency listing is complete for its captured source scope; all expected rule identities/citations and selected current/future/unknown version associations are retained with exact literal parent links.
Each response has actual URL/status/time/body hash/size and known accounting; PDF and Word signatures and parser checks pass without treating HTML error pages as documents.
Captured-input verification, all scope joins, byte caps, immutable outputs and closed inventories pass offline; changed bytes remain review-needed.
Output explicitly reports three selected agencies and fifteen unselected agencies; successful selected capture never promotes department completeness or current law.
failure_criteria: Missing/duplicate/cross-agency rule or version, changed catalog identity, malformed listing, missing exact parent link or guessed document URL.
HTTP denial/not-found/transport failure, unknown accounting, response/aggregate/event/URL/time cap, truncation, corrupt PDF/Word or HTML at a document endpoint.
A partial or interrupted selected agency cannot replace a previous accepted scope; preserve failure and exact preimages, never delete missing sources.
Any attempt to publish through the existing department publisher, write department-16-state.json/inventory, or set full_department_discovery=true must be refused.
limitations: All acquisition evidence is historical. This proposal performs no fresh requests or source acquisition.
Twenty rules, sixty-five distinct URL associations and 10,824,543 received body bytes are independently replayed retained observations, not future size or completeness guarantees.
The department catalog has 18 agencies. Only 137/138/140 are selected; all other rule counts remain outside this plan, not zero.
Source current/future designations and date labels are retained claims, not certified operative law. No visual/native text review or PDF/Word equivalence is performed.
This separate planning schema is deliberately not accepted by the existing department collector/publisher; department 16 remains incomplete.
Raw original receipts contain HTTP headers and stay in historical private custody. Only typed nonsecret projections and raw receipt hashes are copied; hashes do not authenticate transport chronology.
Historical diagnosis manifest is retained as a pin, not a claim that this package copies its full original inventory. No collector or publisher is implemented here.
